article.headline: Marcus Randolph guides Saint Peter's to 66-61 victory over Sacred Heart
article.description: — Marcus Randolph had 18 points to help Saint Peter's turn back Sacred Heart 66-61 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Marcus Randolph guides Saint Peter's to 66-61 victory over Sacred Heart

categories.description: Saint Peter's Peacocks @ Sacred Heart Pioneers

event.description: Saint Peter's Peacocks @ Sacred Heart Pioneers

keywords: Saint Peter's Peacocks @ Sacred Heart Pioneers
article.story: FAIRFIELD, Conn. -- — Marcus Randolph had 18 points to help Saint Peter's turn back Sacred Heart 66-61 on Saturday. Randolph also grabbed six rebounds for the Peacocks (7-8, 2-5 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Mouhamed Sow totaled 12 points and five rebounds. Armoni Zeigler scored 10. Amiri Stewart led the way for the Pioneers (6-12, 2-5) with 21 points, six rebounds and two steals. Anquan Hill added 13 points and six rebounds. Tanner Thomas had 10 points and six boards. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
